:::{#exm-distributive}
#### Multiplication distributes over addition, but not the reverse

- $3 \times (4 + 5) = 3 \times 9 = 27$,
  and $(3 \times 4) + (3 \times 5) = 12 + 15 = 27$.
- Addition does not distribute over multiplication:
  $2 + (3 \times 4) = 2 + 12 = 14$,
  but $(2 + 3) \times (2 + 4) = 5 \times 6 = 30$.

:::
